transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… I just haven’t been feeling like myself lately. It’s probably nothing dramatic, but I’ve kind of stopped doing the things I used to do—hiking, coaching, playing guitar. I don’t really call people back much either.

Some days I’m just in my rental, sitting there for hours, and I know there are things I should do, but I can’t seem to make myself start. I don’t know if that’s the sort of thing you mean.
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things as much as you used to, like you don’t get the same satisfaction out of hiking, coaching, or playing guitar anymore?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but those things just don’t really pull me in anymore. Hiking, coaching, guitar… I used to get something out of them, and now I mostly just don’t start.

Some days I’m just sitting in that little rental for hours, knowing I should do something, call someone back or pick up the guitar, and I just… can’t seem to get myself moving. Is that what you mean?
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for the past couple of weeks?

I don’t know that I’d call it depressed, exactly. I mean, I’m not trying to dodge the question… I just haven’t really been tracking it that way.

I guess I’ve been kind of flat or worn down a lot of the time, but “most of the day, nearly every day” sounds pretty strong. I’m not sure. Is that an okay answer?
Over the past two weeks, have you had days where you felt down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

I’m… not sure I can say that clearly. There have definitely been days where I felt kind of low or heavy, but “most of the day, nearly every day” sounds like a lot, and I don’t want to overstate it.

I guess I’d say I’ve been off more than usual, but I haven’t really kept track of whether it’s been that constant. Is that still useful?
Looking back at the past two weeks, would you say there were more than half of the days when you felt down or low most of the time?

I… I honestly don’t know. More than half sounds like something I should be able to answer, but I haven’t been marking the days or anything.

There were some days I felt pretty low for a good stretch, yeah. But I’m not sure I can say it was most of the time on more than half the days. I don’t want to give you the wrong answer just to be agreeable. Does that make sense?
Looking back over the past two weeks, on the days when you felt low or heavy, would you say that feeling lasted for most of the day?

I’m not totally sure. On those days, it could hang around for a while, like a good chunk of the day, but I don’t know if I’d say most of the day every time.

I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is. Maybe some days it did, but I wasn’t really watching the clock on it. Is that the kind of answer you mean?
On the days when you felt low or heavy, would you say that your mood was depressed or sad rather than just feeling tired or unmotivated?

I’m not completely sure how to separate those, to be honest. It’s not always like I’m crying or anything like that. Sometimes it just feels… heavy, kind of flat.

I guess there are moments where it feels more like sadness than just being tired, but I don’t know if I’d call it full-on depressed. I’m trying to answer it the right way—I don’t want to make it sound more dramatic than it is.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt a lack of energy or felt run down for most of the day on most days?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t want to overstate it, but mostly I just don’t feel like myself anymore.

It’s not only being tired, exactly. I used to hike, coach, play guitar, call people back… normal stuff. Lately I just don’t really do those things. Some days I’m in that small rental for hours, and I know there are things I should do, but I just can’t seem to get myself started.

So… I guess yes, run down or no energy is probably fair. Does that answer it the way you mean?
Over the past two weeks, have you completely lost interest in doing things you used to enjoy, like hiking, coaching, or playing guitar, even for a little while?

Yeah… I guess I have, mostly. I don’t want to say “completely” if that means there’s never even a second where I think about it, but I’m not really doing any of it.

I used to hike, and I was coaching, playing guitar… even calling people back. Now I just kind of don’t. Some days I sit in that small rental for hours, knowing there are things I should get up and do, and I just can’t make myself start.

So… yes, I’ve lost interest in those things, or at least it feels like I’m not myself with them anymore. Is that what you’re asking?
Over the past two weeks, have you had days where your mood felt clearly depressed or sad for most of the day?

I’m… not sure I can say it was clearly sad for most of the day. There are days where I feel heavy or kind of down, but I don’t always know if that counts as depressed.

I don’t want to answer it wrong. Maybe some parts of the day, yeah, but “most of the day” feels harder for me to be certain about.
Looking back at the past two weeks, on how many days would you say that your mood was clearly depressed or sad for most of the day?

I… I don’t know if I can put an exact number on it. I’m sorry.

Maybe a few days where it felt more clearly down, but I’m not sure it was most of the day. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is or give you the wrong number. It’s been kind of blurred together, honestly.
Looking back at the past two weeks, were there more than half of the days when your mood was clearly depressed or sad for most of the day?

I… I’m not sure. More than half sounds like a lot, and I don’t know that I can honestly say that.

There were days I felt down, yeah, but whether it was clearly sad for most of the day on more than seven days… I don’t think I can say that for sure. I don’t want to overstate it. Does that answer it okay?
Looking back at the past two weeks, on how many days would you say you felt a depressed or sad mood for most of the day?

I’m sorry, I’m still having trouble putting a number on it. It’s kind of all run together.

If I had to guess, maybe a few days felt more down, but I don’t feel confident saying it was most of the day. I don’t want to give you a number that’s not right. Is it okay if I just say I’m not sure?
Looking back at the past two weeks, on how many days would you say that your mood was depressed or sad for most of the day? Just your best sense, even if it’s not exact.

I get what you’re asking. Best sense… maybe three or four days? I’m not totally sure they were full days, but there were a few where I felt pretty low for a lot of it.

I don’t want to exaggerate it, but if you need a number, I’d say around three or four.
Looking back at the past two weeks, were there at least seven or eight days when your mood felt depressed or sad for most of the day?

I don’t think so… no. Seven or eight days sounds higher than what I can honestly say.

Like I said, maybe a few days where I felt pretty down for a lot of the day, but I wouldn’t want to say it was half the days if I’m not sure. Is that okay?
Looking back at the past two weeks, would you say there were at least five or six days when your mood felt depressed or sad for most of the day?

I’m not sure it would be five or six, honestly. I mean… it might be closer to that if I’m counting the parts of days where I felt low, but most of the day? I’d still probably say no, not confidently.

Maybe more like a few days. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it was if that makes sense.
Looking back at the past two weeks, would you say there were at least five days when your mood felt depressed or sad for most of the day?

I’m still hesitant to say yes to five full days. I mean, there were definitely some stretches where I felt sad or down, but “most of the day” for five days… I don’t know that I can say that confidently.

Maybe it was close, but I’d rather not overstate it. Does that answer it the way you need?
Looking back at the past two weeks, would you say there were at least five days when your mood felt depressed or sad for most of the day, even if only part of those days felt that way?

If you count “even part of the day,” then… yeah, I guess maybe it could be five days. Not five whole days, but there were probably at least that many where I felt down for a while.

I just don’t want to make it sound like I was depressed all day every day, because it wasn’t like that. Does that make sense?
Looking back at the past two weeks, would you say there were at least five days when your mood felt depressed or sad for most of the day?

I know I keep going back and forth on it, sorry. If we’re talking most of the day, I’m still not totally sure I’d say five days. There were some days I felt pretty low for a while, but I don’t know if it was most of the day that many times.

I guess I’d say… maybe close, but I can’t confidently say yes. Is that okay?
Looking back at the past two weeks, would you say there were at least five days when your mood felt depressed or sad for most of the day?

I’m sorry, I know I’m not giving you a clean yes or no. I don’t think I can honestly say it was at least five days where I was sad for most of the day.

There were times I felt down, sure, but “most of the day” feels like a lot to say. I’d rather be careful than make it sound worse than it was. Is that alright?
